title: feat(ui): viewport Display menu with four display modes, Look at and graphics switches
body:
## What changed

- The viewport toolbar has a new button, "Display". It opens a menu above the toolbar.
- The menu has three groups:
  - **Display mode** (one choice): "Shaded, with edges", "Shaded", "Wireframe", "Shaded, with hidden edges".
  - **Look at**: "Look at a face". The next click on a face turns the view to face it.
  - **Graphics**: "Grid", "Origin axes", "Perspective view", "Orthographic view".
- Each entry has a tooltip. The active entries show a check mark (radio or check box).
- Each entry is view state. No entry queues a command.
- `draw_list::plan` gives the draw list of each display mode. `View3D::render_with` follows it.
- "Shaded" draws no wire on the model and on the stock.
- "Shaded, with hidden edges" draws the cached model edges a second time behind the faces, in a lighter tone. It builds no new buffer.
- The display mode and the grid switch are saved in the per-user `view.json`, with the gizmo names. An old file without the keys loads the defaults.
- The display mode choice moved out of the Browser pane ("Solids" radios). The Projection radios stay there.
- The wireframe button stays. One press gives wireframe from each mode.

Not in this PR: the quality preset, the ground shadow, the ambient occlusion, and "Look at" for a plane that is not a model face. Issue #2834 has them. #2818 permits this split.

The fourth mode of #2636 ("Wireframe, see-through") is not in this PR. #2636 stays open for it.

## Cause

This is new work that the maintainer asked for in #2818. The viewport had two display modes and no menu for them.

## Screenshots

Before (unchanged `main` at 380c29b3c):

| Browser "View" door with the "Solids" radios | Shaded | Wireframe |
|---|---|---|
| ![before view door](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/issue-2818/before-browser-view-door.png) | ![before shaded](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/issue-2818/before-shaded.png) | ![before wireframe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/issue-2818/before-wireframe.png) |

After. The Display menu:

![after display menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/issue-2818/after-display-menu.png)

After. The four modes (the stock is hidden, so that the model shows):

| Shaded, with edges | Shaded |
|---|---|
| ![after shaded edges](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/issue-2818/after-shaded-edges.png) | ![after shaded](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/issue-2818/after-shaded.png) |

| Wireframe | Shaded, with hidden edges |
|---|---|
| ![after wireframe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/issue-2818/after-wireframe.png) | ![after hidden edges](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/issue-2818/after-shaded-hidden-edges.png) |

The screenshots come from the off-screen harness of the guide images. They are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. No image is in this branch.

## Tests

Pins (all new, all green on the head):

- `ui::draw_list::tests` (6 tests): the draw list of each display mode, the traced stock, the empty document.
- `egui_app::tests::display_menu` (6 tests):
  - `the_display_button_opens_and_closes_the_menu_and_the_labels_exist`
  - `each_display_mode_entry_sets_the_mode_and_shows_the_check`
  - `the_graphics_entries_set_their_fields`
  - `look_at_turns_the_view_to_face_the_clicked_face`
  - `look_at_on_empty_space_changes_nothing_and_says_so`
  - `the_display_mode_and_the_grid_are_kept_in_the_view_file`
- `egui_app::tests::page_layout_windows::layout_window_display_menu`: the layout test of the menu and its toolbar button.
- `egui_app::viewport_bar::tests::display_button_toggles_the_menu_and_wire_works_from_each_mode`
- `display_mode::tests::each_mode_has_its_own_label_tooltip_and_key`
- `gpu_render::shaded_drops_the_wire_and_hidden_edges_add_the_far_wire` (a real GPU pass, it compiles the new shader stage).
- `view_file::the_display_mode_and_the_grid_round_trip_and_an_old_file_loads_the_defaults` (`camcraft-app`).

Red before the change: the pins use new types, so they do not compile on unchanged `main`. The mutation checks below show that each guard is pinned.

Mutation results (the guard was broken, the pin went red, the guard was restored, the pin went green):

| Broken guard | Red test |
|---|---|
| `plan`: "Shaded" draws the model edges | `shaded_draws_faces_and_no_edges` |
| `plan`: "Shaded" draws the stock edges | `shaded_draws_faces_and_no_edges` |
| `plan`: no hidden-edge step | `shaded_with_hidden_edges_draws_the_model_edges_two_times`, `gpu_render::shaded_drops_the_wire...` |
| hidden-edge pipeline with `LessEqual` in place of `Greater` | `gpu_render::shaded_drops_the_wire_and_hidden_edges_add_the_far_wire` |
| `shell.rs`: the armed click is not sent to `look_at::click` | the two `look_at_*` tests |
| `interact.rs`: the grid ignores `show_grid` | `the_graphics_entries_set_their_fields` |
| `state_view.rs`: the display mode is not loaded | `the_display_mode_and_the_grid_are_kept_in_the_view_file` |
| `view.rs`: no serde default for `display` | `view_file` (3 tests), `the_display_mode_and_the_grid_are_kept_in_the_view_file` |
| `viewport_bar.rs`: the wireframe switch ignores the new modes | `display_button_toggles_the_menu_and_wire_works_from_each_mode` |
| `display_menu.rs`: a press on the button counts as "click elsewhere" | 5 `display_menu` tests, `layout_window_display_menu`, `click_toggles_view_state` |

Changed tests (the change explains each):

- `click_toggles_view_state` opens the Display menu for "Wireframe". The radio left the Browser pane.
- `view_names.rs` and `view_file.rs` build `ViewPrefs` with `..ViewPrefs::default()`. The structure has two new fields.

Gate on the head: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is green (21 steps, 0 failed). `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean. The last commit after the gate changes one doc comment only; `cargo check -p camcraft-ui` passed on it.

## Goldens moved

None. No `.nc` file, no `.cl` file and no snapshot PNG changed.

## Not exercised

- The heavy lanes (`cargo xtask gate heavy`) did not run.
- The wasm build did not run. The menu and the render pass use only code that the two shells share.
- No frame time measurement on a large model. The hidden-edge mode adds one indexed line draw of the cached edge buffer.
- "Look at" on the machined stock mesh. The click uses the uncut stock triangle.
- The pixel snapshots (release lane). The toolbar is one button wider, so the cut must make the viewport goldens new.
- No person used the menu in the real window.

## Overlaps

- #2783 (`needs-rework`, `conflicts`) changes `viewport_bar.rs`: it adds tooltip text after `NAVS` and changes lines in `act` and `draw`. This PR adds `Nav::Display` to the same lists and one arm to `act` and `draw`. It touches the same functions on different lines. Whichever merges second refreshes, and #2783 then needs a tooltip for `Nav::Display`.
- #2786 changes `browser()` in `browser_pane.rs` at a different line (the Delete entry). Whichever merges second refreshes.
- #2821, #2773, #2764, #2763, #2737, #2678 change `state.rs` or `egui_app/tests.rs` in other functions.

No new command, so no MCP tool is owed. Decision record: `docs/decisions/2818-viewport-display-menu.md`.

Effort: high

Changelog: The viewport toolbar has a Display menu: four display modes (Shaded with edges, Shaded, Wireframe, Shaded with hidden edges), "Look at a face", and switches for the grid, the origin axes and the projection. The display mode is kept between sessions.

Fixes #2818
